articles.summary: Going into your first mental health session can be daunting, and that's totally normal and valid. You already deserve congratulations for getting this far! Having a better idea of how your first session will go could help you mentally prepare, so read on to find out more.
articles.title: What to Expect for Your First Mental Health Session

articles.summary: Annual Physical Exams or APEs are a common enough benefit we've all availed of, but as an HR or business owner, understanding how they work and what to expect from HMOs ultimately allows you to manage employee health programs that cultivate the culture of care you want for your team.
articles.title: Annual Physical Exams in the Philippines: What to Expect from your HMO
